summary: This trace demonstrates a successful queue capacity planning task for radiology reading backlog, using the same core simulation logic as the existing SOC alert queue skill but with domain-specific terminology and parameters. The agent successfully adapted the pattern: 6-day surge → 5-day transition → 4-day steady state, with step-up reversion when demand exceeds threshold. Key insights: (1) The existing queue-capacity-planning skill's framework is reusable across domains (radiology, SOC, etc.) with only CONFIG changes, (2) Header names and terminology vary by domain but structure remains identical, (3) The deterministic policy with negative buffer tracking works correctly, (4) Summary format requirements vary slightly by task (2 vs 3 sentences). The skill should be generalized to support multiple domain variants rather than creating parallel skills.
